# README visual assets

`api-levels.svg`, `hybrid-pipeline.svg`, `projected-per-view-processing.svg`,
and `sphere-native-processing.svg` are original PanorAi explanatory diagrams
derived from the documented public API and geometry contracts. They contain no
third-party image, benchmark result, model output, or generated scientific
evidence.

They use a white-background scientific-figure language: Arial/Helvetica text,
thin axes and grid lines, restrained fills, and a MATLAB-like default color
sequence. The palette is descriptive styling only; no MATLAB asset or output is
embedded.

The photographic mosaics embedded by the repository README remain the tracked
derivatives in `../tutorials/`. Their source, license, generation procedure,
parameters, interpretation, and SHA-256 digests are recorded in
`../tutorials/ATTRIBUTION.md` and `../tutorials/application-gallery-metadata.json`.
